steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each unit reports up its reporting line. A line that loops back is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Reporting line loops
findings.fix: Break the loop in the reporting lines

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] lines.csv:12  Reporting line loops.
       Fix: Break the loop in the reporting lines.
[medium] unit-sales.md:19  Unit with no manager.
       Fix: Name a manager.
[low] design-principles.md:26  Unit with no stated purpose.

Not checked: The people in the roles.
pros: Checks a unit with no manager, a reporting line that loops, and a unit with no stated purpose.
cons: Not checked: The people in the roles.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-org-design-review skill on the records for this review.
